metadata.title: Link invariants in nilpotent group gauge theories
metadata.abstract: We consider 3-dimensional topological gauge theories with nilpotent gauge groups, both finite, that is Dijkgraaf-Witten theories, and continuous, that is Chern-Simons theories. Abelian topological quantum field theories are exactly those which do not detect the Borromean rings, and nilpotent gauge groups provide the natural next steps beyond the abelian case. We show that the untwisted Dijkgraaf-Witten theory with gauge group $G$ detects Brunnian links with up to $n+1$ components, but no Brunnian links with more components, if and only if $G$ is $n$-step nilpotent. Moreover, the expectation values of such links are determined by their Milnor invariants. We also study the properties of Chern-Simons theories with nilpotent Lie groups and draw parallels with those of the Dijkgraaf-Witten theories. Finally, we conjecture, using the Lazard correspondence, a relation between expectation values of line operators in the two types of theories, and test it in examples.

analysis.progressType: 幂零规范群的 Brunnian 链环检测阈值
analysis.workSummary: 有限群 G 的无扭 Dijkgraaf–Witten 理论中，G 恰为 n 步幂零等价于可检测的 Brunnian 链环分量数阈值为 n+1。各分量数可用相应的 Milnor 链环测试，检测指存在染色使期望值区别于相同分量数、染色和标架的平凡链环。n 步幂零时，n+1 分量链环的期望值由其长度 n+1 的 Milnor 不变量决定。
techniques: Brunnian 链环与 Milnor 不变量
analysis.breakthrough: 把规范群的幂零层数与拓扑场论可检测的 Brunnian 链环分量数联系起来。
analysis.limitations: 阈值针对有限群的无扭理论，检测能力通过特定 Milnor 链环刻画。文章还比较幂零 Lie 群 Chern–Simons 理论，两类理论间的线算子期望值关系以 Lazard 对应为线索提出猜想，并在例子中检验。解读依据摘要及第3–4、25、27页主陈述。
analysis.aiEvidence: PDF 第47页说明作者用 Anthropic Claude 做公式的数值和符号核对、生成所有图形、协助第6节和附录 C 的部分推导及编辑部分文字。作者称验证了全部结果。第31页 O₁ 为余伴随轨道符号。
